ai.summary: Xalgorix, an open-source AI penetration testing tool, checks its work before it reports anything. When its main agent finds a bug, a second agent has to exploit that bug again. If the second agent can’t prove the bug is real or rule it out, Xalgorix keeps the finding and flags it for a person to review. The check targets false positives, findings that look like vulnerabilities and turn out to be harmless. ai.summary: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week. The flaw allows an attacker with no account to write files outside the server's storage folder, and it affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup,
ai.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
